semantics: Replace native product write at selected positions with opposite endpoint write at aligned addresses, preserving Down bias. Changed-token positions use index equality only for equal-length prompts: this is an address-based contrast, not semantic alignment. Final positions align explicitly even with unequal lengths. Donors may change multiple linguistic variables. Intervene one layer/region at a time; no simultaneous layer patch.
metrics: Final full-vocabulary native-weighted squared logprob response, output KL, intended-vs-alternate margin change, task competence and raw delta energy. No norm matching or amplitudes. Identity retained. Direction of margin decrease is descriptive, not a task-isolation guarantee.
selection: All66 existing training pairs plus4color pairs. No competence/effect filtering or evaluation pairs. Keep every source alignment failure. No representation training or best-site selection.
stop: One fixed native coverage map across all families/layers/regions, independently audit. Use informative and null targets together for subsequent common-target featurizer design; do not tune per-family layers based on outcomes.
